content.title: 🌿 Muslims Day Now Has 284 Active Ansars!
content.subtitle: A Blessed Friday to Invest in Your Akhirah.
content.body:
As you know, we launched the Muslims Day Ansar (Supporters) initiative in May of this year. Alhamdulillah, while 629 brothers and sisters have already joined this Dawah mission, 284 are currently active as regular members. We sincerely hope your participation in this noble effort multiplies, enabling us to easily reach our goal of 2,000 Ansars and deliver the message of Deen to millions of people.

May Allah Ta'ala grant us all the ability to achieve this. Ameen.

🎯 What is Muslims Day’s Mission?

Muslims Day’s goal is not merely to run an app. Our dream is to build a platform that helps millions of Muslims grow closer to Allah every single day—supporting them in reading the Quran, becoming mindful of Salah, learning Duas, and guiding their families toward the path of Islam.

Within the next 6 months, we aim to reach 10 million app installations for Muslims Day, Insha'Allah—so that even more people can access authentic Islamic knowledge, practice good deeds, and nurture spiritual purification.

🤝 Who are Muslims Day Ansars?

Sustaining this mission requires consistent financial support. Out of millions of users, we are looking for just 2,000 Ansars who will contribute 500 BDT per month to be part of this Sadaqah Jariyah.

They are not merely premium subscribers—they are true companions in this Dawah journey.

📊 Our Next Goal

To complete the caravan of 2,000 Ansars, we still need 1,716 more supporters.

Your contribution is vital to this journey of bringing beneficial Islamic knowledge to 10 million Muslims. Perhaps Allah Ta'ala will spread the light of Deen to countless others through you.

💎 What are the Benefits of Becoming an Ansar?

  • ✅ A share in the ongoing good deeds of millions of people

  • ✅ 7 Premium Subscriptions of Muslims Day

  • ✅ FREE access to special online Halaqahs, seminars, and exclusive events

However, the greatest reward is becoming part of a continuous service to the Deen.

🌙 A Decision on This Blessed Day of Jumu'ah

A monthly contribution of 500 BDT may not be a huge amount for you—perhaps just the cost of a single snack at a restaurant! Yet, this modest support can become a Sadaqah Jariyah whose rewards continue flowing even after your death, Insha'Allah.

footer_button.hint: On this blessed day of Jumu'ah, join us as a Muslims Day Ansar. Insha'Allah, this could be one of the most beautiful investments for your Akhirah.
